name: mcp-imslp
description: MCP server for IMSLP, the Petrucci Music Library. Read works, scores and recordings. No API key required.
long_description: Search the works and the people of IMSLP, read a work with its facets in the wording its page used, page through the editions it holds with their publishers, editors and copyright status per jurisdiction, and browse a genre, a key or an instrumentation. No API key, no account, read-only, and no score file is ever downloaded.

tools.name: search_works
tools.description: Search the works of IMSLP by title, by composer, or by words printed on their pages.

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Find the composers, editors, arrangers and performers of IMSLP by name.

tools.name: get_work
tools.description: Read one work: its titles, composer, catalogue numbers, dates, key, instrumentation and the terms its scores are published under.

tools.name: list_work_files
tools.description: Read the scores and recordings a work holds, edition by edition, with the copyright status of each.

tools.name: list_person_works
tools.description: Read the works IMSLP files under a person, as a composer, an editor, an arranger or a performer.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: Read what IMSLP holds about a person: the name its page prints, the life dates it states, and the registers holding a record of them.

tools.name: browse_category
tools.description: Read the works IMSLP files under a genre, a key, an instrumentation or a period.
